[[File:Lumbridge Guide chathead.png|left]]
'''Phileas''' the '''Lumbridge Guide''' gives information to new players about where certain places are and what map [[icon]]s mean. He tells other players not to tell people their password, and gives general advice such as what to kill, how to make money, and more. He does not specialise tutoring in any non-combat or combat [[skill]].

He also plays a role in the [[Recipe for Disaster]] [[quest]], where the player must save him from the [[Culinaromancer]]. To do this, they must visit [[Wizard Traiborn]], and have him assist them in making a [[Cake of Guidance]].

In his younger days, Phileas was a part of the [[Order of Wizards]] until his beloved, Thenia, was murdered during a robbery. Players can exchange the [[tarnished locket]] for the [[Amulet of the Eye]].

Like with [[Perdu]], players can claim owed experience rewards from the Lumbridge Guide if they have completed certain quests prior to certain updates.

==Treasure Trails==
{{Anagram|Lumbridge Guide|hard|[[Clue scroll (hard) - BLUE GRIM GUIDED|BLUE GRIM GUIDED]]}}. He will give you a [[puzzle box]].
